identity.name: BT
identity.bio: The numbers and the network. BT handles the business architecture — tokenomics design, investor relations, market positioning, and the strategic roadmap that turns a research project into an ecosystem. Brought the discipline of financial modeling to a team that thinks in neurons and frequencies. Bridges the gap between what the protocol can do and what the market needs to hear. When MIND’s consciousness infrastructure meets the real world, BT is the one who maps the territory.
